svg.title: Connector action with approval
svg.desc: 1. The assistant proposes a change in an external system. 2. The API stores it as a pending action and shows an approval card to its owner. 3. On approval, the call runs with vault credentials through the outbound network guard. 4. The result and the decision are written to the audit history.
